name: New Year
overview: Scripture reveals that the New Year is a time marked by God's goodness crowning the year and His provision sustaining His people (Psalms 65:11). Believers are encouraged to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding as they face new beginnings (Proverbs 3:5). The promise of renewed strength comes to those who wait on the Lord, enabling them to rise above weariness and embrace fresh opportunities (Isaiah 40:31). God calls His people to forget past failures and look forward to the new things He will accomplish, providing hope and direction even in difficult circumstances (Isaiah 43:18-19; Jeremiah 29:11).
